contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime residential East Asian city lane with tiled shopfronts, a convenience store, potted plants, utility poles and overhead wires; dry asphalt, no rain depicted; humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The rice cracker and its paper wrapper are scene props. Seated pose: the cargo trousers' full leg length and the tote's hidden side are conservatively reconstructed. Hidden backs and soles are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 27 isolated products have complete silhouettes, matching garment colors and visible details, clean alpha edges across four backgrounds, matching footwear/sock pairs, gold hoop pair and complete watch. No props or forced running trim. Look05 jeans retain visible rear construction; hidden garment fronts are conservative reconstructions. No visible matte, checkerboard or external shadow.

deck.ko: 세이지, 검정, 밝은 스톤의 편안한 층.
deck.en: Easy layers in sage, black and pale stone.
deck.de: Entspannte Lagen in Salbei, Schwarz und hellem Stein.

intro.ko: 낮은 벤치에 앉아 잠시 포장을 여는 쉬는 시간입니다.
intro.en: A low bench offers a brief pause to open a snack wrapper.
intro.de: Auf einer niedrigen Bank wird kurz eine Snackverpackung geöffnet.

body.ko: 큰 패치 주머니의 세이지 재킷 아래 검정 니트를 두어 중심을 잡았습니다. 넓은 스톤 카고는 앉은 자세에서도 다리선을 읽게 하고, 짙은 회색 캔버스화가 밝은 바지 끝을 정돈합니다. 부드러운 검정 토트는 니트와 같은 색으로 연결됩니다. 플래시는 주머니와 무릎의 접힘을 선명하게 보여줍니다.
body.en: A black knit anchors the sage jacket with its large patch pockets. Broad stone cargo legs remain readable in the seated pose, with dark gray canvas shoes grounding the pale hems. The soft black tote repeats the knit color. Flash defines the pockets and bends at the knees.
body.de: Ein schwarzer Pullover gibt der salbeigrünen Jacke mit großen Taschen eine klare Mitte. Die weite steinfarbene Cargo bleibt auch im Sitzen erkennbar. Dunkelgraue Canvas-Schuhe schließen die hellen Säume ab, die weiche schwarze Tasche wiederholt den Pulloverton. Blitz betont Taschen und Kniefalten.

pull.en: A black center steadies pale cargo.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A black center steadies pale cargo.

tip.ko: 앉을 때 토트를 허벅지 위 대신 옆에 두어 카고 주머니를 가리지 마세요.
tip.en: Place the tote beside you instead of over the thighs to leave the cargo pockets visible.
tip.de: Die Tasche neben sich statt auf die Oberschenkel stellen, damit die Cargotaschen sichtbar bleiben.

description.ko: 차분한 세이지색에 칼라와 앞여밈, 큰 덮개 패치 주머니의 재킷.
description.en: Muted sage jacket with a collar, front fastening and large flap patch pockets.
description.de: Gedämpft salbeigrüne Jacke mit Kragen, Frontverschluss und großen Klappentaschen.

howToWear.ko: 검정 니트가 목과 중앙에 보이게 재킷을 열어 입으세요.
howToWear.en: Open the jacket to show black at the neck and center.
howToWear.de: Die Jacke öffnen und Schwarz an Hals und Mitte zeigen.
